app.title: Boot a Virtual iPhone via Apple's Virtualization.framework
app.author: hentrep
app.description: A command‑line utility that uses macOS's Virtualization.framework to launch an iOS simulator without Xcode.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `cargo build --release`
Execute `vphone-cli --list` to enumerate available device templates
Start a virtual phone with `vphone-cli --device iPhone-15 --ram 2GB` and verify the VM boots
Run `vphone-cli --shutdown` to gracefully stop the VM
